notes.title: Permanent Price Reduction
notes.notes: Minute Fighter's price has been permanently reduced down to about 2 dollars. In hindsight this is probably how it should have been since launch. There are a lot of things I wish I had done differently.

notes.title: Horizontal Mouse Inversion.
notes.notes:
Horizonta[b]l[/b] mouse movement can now be inverted, t[b]h[/b]is can be toggled in the settings [b]m[/b]enu.

Let me know if you find any game-breaking bugs.

notes.title: Difficulty selection, minor fixes.
notes.notes:
An easy mode has been added, it can be selected in the options menu. 
In addition, a number of very minor issues have been resolved, and several more have, no doubt, been created.

When I started this project I was a lot worse of a programmer than I am now, and as such the codebase is something of a disaster. I'm not sure how much more I can put up with it, although I'll try to keep important changes coming as much as I can.
